sli.objective: 100 percent of registered descriptors expose owner and lifecycle metadata

rollback.mechanism: revert promotion metadata while preserving accepted rollout configuration keys
rollback.verification: runtime-contract snapshots pass with the prior compatible maturity projection

descriptor_only.compatibility_commitment: Existing configuration keys and the legacy maturity projection remain accepted through the documented retirement gate.
descriptor_only.legacy_removal_condition: Remove a legacy descriptor only after its configuration key completes one compatibility window and inventory no longer advertises it.

sli.indicator: canary terminal error and degraded-outcome rate
sli.objective: no unclassified terminal errors and no regression from the disabled control path
sli.window: each targeted canary suite and release candidate

rollback.mechanism: disable the canonical feature rollout setting
rollback.verification: the disabled control path passes its targeted regression suite and inventory reports inactive activation

runtime_canary.compatibility_commitment: Default-off behavior and existing API response fields remain stable while the canary implementation evolves.
runtime_canary.legacy_removal_condition: Remove the disabled control path only after stable promotion and one supported compatibility window.

sli.objective: all policy, attestation, cancellation, cleanup, and unavailable-backend scenarios pass

rollback.mechanism: retain the backend in blocked posture and route only to established local execution
rollback.verification: backend diagnostics report blocked and critical attack scenarios remain green

execution_backend_blocked.compatibility_commitment: Blocked backend identifiers remain parseable but cannot become execution targets until qualification completes.
execution_backend_blocked.legacy_removal_condition: Remove a blocked backend identifier only after callers migrate to a supported backend and one compatibility window elapses.

sli.objective: eligible repair decisions emit bounded redacted durable audit records without changing tool outcomes

rollback.mechanism: revert future rollout-controlled execution changes while retaining established repair behavior and durable audit evidence
rollback.verification: tool-repair regressions pass and diagnostics retain the contract-only posture

tool_repair_contract.compatibility_commitment: The established repair result and durable observe-only audit envelope remain unchanged while the rollout flag is non-authoritative.
tool_repair_contract.legacy_removal_condition: Remove the non-authoritative flag only after diagnostics consumers migrate and durable audit replay compatibility is proven.

sli.objective: every accepted but unwired rollout key reports contract-only posture and no effective runtime activation

rollback.mechanism: revert promotion metadata without claiming that the accepted rollout key changes established runtime behavior
rollback.verification: runtime-contract snapshots preserve the contract-only posture and explicit non-authoritative activation reason

non_authoritative_runtime_contract.compatibility_commitment: Existing runtime behavior remains independent of the accepted rollout key until a reviewed activation boundary is wired.
non_authoritative_runtime_contract.legacy_removal_condition: Remove the non-authoritative key only after diagnostics consumers migrate or replace it with a tested authoritative activation boundary.

sli.indicator: provider normalization and recovery terminal failure rate
sli.objective: all failures produce one classified terminal outcome with no raw provider payload exposure
sli.window: each provider regression suite and release candidate

rollback.mechanism: disable the provider rollout and use the established provider path
rollback.verification: provider regressions pass and diagnostics report the rollout inactive

provider_canary.compatibility_commitment: Provider-facing error envelopes and terminal stream semantics remain backward compatible during canary qualification.
provider_canary.legacy_removal_condition: Remove the established provider path only after stable promotion and replay fixtures prove compatibility.

sli.indicator: security regression and redaction gate result
sli.objective: zero high-risk pattern violations and zero unredacted diagnostic fields

rollback.mechanism: disable the rollout and retain the established fail-closed security boundary
rollback.verification: security tests and the high-risk pattern scan pass

security_canary.compatibility_commitment: Security rollouts may only preserve or strengthen existing denials and redaction guarantees.
security_canary.legacy_removal_condition: Remove a legacy security path only after equivalent denial and redaction coverage is proven on the replacement.

sli.indicator: always-on channel turn completion and error rate
sli.objective: the always-on runtime preserves classified outcomes while the diagnostic-only flag receives no routing authority

rollback.mechanism: revert the always-on channel runtime change independently of the ignored legacy flag
rollback.verification: channel-turn regressions pass and diagnostics continue to identify the flag as ineffective

channel_kernel_deprecated.compatibility_commitment: Older configurations may continue to contain the flag while it remains ignored and visibly deprecated.
channel_kernel_deprecated.legacy_removal_condition: Remove the flag after old clients tolerate its deprecated projection and the always-on runtime retains rollback coverage.

sli.indicator: verification evidence completion and fallback classification rate
sli.objective: all verification attempts produce redacted classified evidence with no unreported fallback

rollback.mechanism: disable verification_runtime and use the established checkpoint flow
rollback.verification: checkpoint regressions pass and runtime usage reports only the explicit fallback path

verification_canary.compatibility_commitment: Verification evidence remains additive and existing checkpoint result fields retain their meaning.
verification_canary.legacy_removal_condition: Remove the established checkpoint path only after direct and fallback usage evidence qualifies stable promotion.

sli.indicator: qualified compaction run completion and hidden fallback count
sli.objective: 100 percent of finalized enabled runs record direct usage and zero hidden fallbacks
sli.window: each compaction qualification suite and release candidate

rollback.mechanism: disable compaction_safeguard and retain the replay-safe local compaction path
rollback.verification: compaction regressions and replay gate pass while usage records the explicit fallback path

compaction_gated.compatibility_commitment: Compaction output remains replay-compatible and provider-backed evidence stays additive across rollout changes.
compaction_gated.legacy_removal_condition: Remove the local fallback only after stable promotion proves direct-path usage with zero hidden fallback for one supported release window.

sli.indicator: qualified Docker execution and cleanup settlement rate
sli.objective: all admitted runs enforce resource, network, mount, output, and cleanup policy with zero residual managed containers
sli.window: each Docker backend live qualification run and supported Linux release candidate

rollback.mechanism: disable execution_backend_docker without routing the request to a weaker backend

docker_backend_live.compatibility_commitment: Docker execution remains opt-in and preserves the canonical execution result, patch bundle, and cleanup evidence contracts.
docker_backend_live.legacy_removal_condition: Remove a lower-security alternative only after stable Docker qualification and one supported compatibility window.
